prev.description: The API's link to the previous page, or null on the first page and past the last one.

results.description: Up to 20 characters, in id order. Empty when nothing matches or the page is past the last one.

description: Look up characters, locations and episodes from the Rick and Morty TV show with the free, keyless Rick and Morty API. It covers seasons 1 to 5 only: 51 episodes, ending with S05E10, as the API's data has not been updated since season 5 ended in 2021. No account or API key required.
